pages.text: Wargs require armor tailored specifically for their larger frames. Their harnesses cannot be exchanged with ordinary Wolf Armor, and must be equipped by their owner.

You can remove the armor from your Warg using Shears. If the armor is damaged, you can repair it on an Anvil with the corresponding metal ingot, or simply right-click the armored Warg while holding the corresponding metal ingot—though this will restore less durability.
